description: Replace the site's pages with an existing website's (Squarespace, Wix or anything else: its sitemap, or failing that its home page's links, says which pages), word for word, at the same paths, with its images copied across. A Wiki.js wiki becomes the site's wiki: the whole site, or with `at` the wiki under that path beside its pages, so a site and its wiki on two hosts come together as one. Runs in the background for a minute or two: poll get_site until `job` is null, or read its error.

at.description: For a Wiki.js wiki only: the path to put it under on a site of pages, e.g. wiki. Left out, the wiki is the whole site.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: import_site
title: Move a website in
